title: Fix mobile usability and layout issues across core scoring flows

requirements.text: Identify and fix the specific mobile runtime/UI failure(s) preventing the app from being usable on mobile browsers (at minimum: Match Setup, Matches Dashboard, and Live Scoring), and ensure the primary user flows work end-to-end on small screens (create match, start innings, record runs/extras/wicket, undo, and navigate back).

quotes: it is not working in mobile

acceptanceCriteria: On iOS Safari and Android Chrome sized viewports (~360–430px wide), the app loads without a blank screen and without uncaught runtime errors in the console.

A user can complete the core flow on mobile: create a match in Match Setup, start the first innings, land on Live Scoring, record at least 6 legal balls plus an extra (wide/no-ball), use Undo, and navigate back to the dashboard.
If any step fails (e.g., match creation/start innings/navigation), the user sees an English toast error that describes what failed, and the console contains a useful error log (not a silent failure).

requirements.text: Make the global layout and header mobile-safe: prevent horizontal overflow/clipping, ensure header content (brand, status, home, login/logout) remains usable on narrow widths, and ensure the banner image does not force layout overflow or excessive vertical space on small screens.

quotes: it is not working in mobile

acceptanceCriteria: No horizontal scrolling is required on mobile on any core page (Dashboard, Match Setup, Live Scoring, Summaries).
Header actions remain accessible on mobile (connectivity badge, home button, login/logout) without overlapping or being pushed off-screen.
The header banner image remains contained within the viewport width and uses a mobile-appropriate height (does not dominate the screen).

requirements.text: Improve mobile usability of form and selection controls in Match Setup and Live Scoring (inputs, selects, dialogs): ensure dialogs and dropdown content are scrollable on small screens, inputs remain visible when the on-screen keyboard is open, and primary actions remain easy to tap.

quotes: it is not working in mobile

acceptanceCriteria: On mobile, the Match Setup selects (opening batters/bowler) and Live Scoring dialogs (wicket, extras, new bowler) can be opened, interacted with, and closed without content being cut off.
Dialog content fits within the viewport height with internal scrolling when needed (no controls inaccessible off-screen).
Touch targets for the primary scoring actions (0–6, wicket, extras, undo) are comfortably tappable on mobile and do not require precision taps.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn UI components); compose or wrap them instead if mobile behavior needs adjustment.
Do not edit immutable hook files: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add migration if state changes require it.
nonGoals: Do not add a native mobile app or React Native build.
Do not add PWA installability/offline caching via service workers unless required to fix the reported mobile failure.
Do not introduce new third-party auth providers or external databases/services.
